content: Why do you stay in prison when the door is so wide open?
author: Rumi
story:
Following the sudden disappearance of his beloved spiritual mentor Shams-i-Tabrizi in 1247, Rumi was plunged into inconsolable grief. Refusing despair, he turned his heartbreak into devotional verse and ecstatic whirling prayer in Konya, discovering that human sorrow breaks open the ego so divine illumination can flood the soul.

In formulating this reflection, Rumi stripped away superficial conventions to address the core anatomy of freedom. For Rumi, true wisdom is never an abstract luxury, but an urgent practical discipline required to navigate life with clarity and unshakeable dignity.
reflectionPrompt: How can you integrate the essence of this wisdom into one specific decision or encounter today?
